description: Move a QUEUED workflow run into the priority lane: the runner claims it ahead of the class order, highest `level` first (normal < high < critical), then oldest (issue #10898). The lane holds at most a third of the runner slots, so prioritizing many runs cannot starve the rest. Calling again on a prioritized queued run changes its level. Only queued runs; a running or finished run is reported, not changed. Requires 'repo' scope and write access; `high` and `critical` also require a site admin.

level.description: normal (default) | high | critical — high and critical need a site admin

run_id.description: The run's id, or a unique leading part of it (8+ hex characters)

name: gluecron_prioritize_workflow_run
